question: Which of the following voluntary organization has won the Skoll Prize for Social Entrepreneurship 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ARMMAN.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **ARMMAN **is one of the winners of the Skoll Award for **Social Entrepreneurship 2020.**
 
• It was awarded its exceptional work in the maternal and child health space in India.
 
• This is appreciated that ARMMAN was selected from **700 organizations and was the only organization from Asia and Africa.**
 
• Each awardee receives a **USD 1.5 million investment.**
